answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 5 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a copper bet on surviving 119 epochs of grading, and every reef settlement recomputes the dawn schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 119 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 40 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
